title: A Tale of Two Cities
author: Charles Dickens
summary: Set between London and Paris in the years leading up to and through the French Revolution, this novel follows a wrongly accused man, the woman he loves, and a worn-out lawyer who looks strikingly like him.
readIf: you want a classic with a famous opening, a sweeping historical backdrop and a final act that lands hard.
skipIf: you dislike Victorian prose, long sentences or a slow first half before the plot tightens.

pairings.reason: Another large-hearted tale of revolutionary France where mercy and sacrifice matter as much as the politics.
Also set in a turbulent France, with a faster, more plot-driven pace and plenty of satisfying reversals.
Shows another world coming apart through political upheaval, told in a more modern, sharp-edged voice.
